description: Aménagements cyclables sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche de lignes localise les aménagements cyclables réalisés sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole. Ci-dessous, une définition des différents types d'aménagements cyclables présents dans la couche de données: - Bandes cyclables: Elles se trouvent sur la chaussée. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are bicyclette, zone piétonnière, automobile, mode de transport. The portal shows 2,152 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-07-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
